title: Immich: make it better
summary: After first upload works: disk headroom, backups of Immich itself, and one more user. Not a rewrite.

start.body: Uploads already work. Now keep Immich from eating the disk and make sure you can rebuild it.

disk.body:
Check the photo disk once a week for the first month, using your own UPLOAD_LOCATION path:

```
df -h /srv/photos
```

If the photos share the system disk and it passes 80%, move them before it fills.

backup-immich.body:
Phone upload is not a backup of Immich. Immich writes a database dump every night into backups inside UPLOAD_LOCATION and keeps the last 14, so one copy of that whole folder to the backup USB covers photos and database:

```
sudo rsync -a --delete /srv/photos/immich/ /mnt/backup/immich/
```

users.body: If someone else in the house will upload, give them their own account: Administration, Users, Create user. Shared albums beat one giant admin pile.

choices.label: Done for now — keep Immich marked installed
I want the lighter Prism path instead

pivot-prism.body: Fine. Leave Immich running or stop it — your call. Prism: first install is there when you want fewer moving parts.

done.body:
Immich stays installed. Keep port 2283 closed on the router. To update, read the release notes first, then in ~/immich-app:

```
sudo docker compose pull && sudo docker compose up -d
```

Remote access is a separate, careful project. Not today.
